name: Publish VS Code Extension

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "vscode-v*"

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"

      - name: Install deps
        run: cd vscode-zifer && npm install

      - name: Package extension
        run: cd vscode-zifer && npx vsce package

      - name: Publish to Marketplace
        run: cd vscode-zifer && npx vsce publish -p ${{ secrets.VSCE_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload .vsix artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zifer-vscode-extension
          path: vscode-zifer/*.vsix
